# Will your ADU pay for itself?

> ADU payback calculator for homeowners and builders. Enter build cost, loan, rent and operating costs and see cash flow, yield on cost, payback, IRR, NPV and break-even rent. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
